scope: Publish production hierarchical-query evidence with immutable local aliases.
limitations: GPU-versus-GPU traversal gains do not meet the comparable-quality native CPU speed goal.
Native trace and sanitizer durations are diagnostic, not clean timing samples.
Fresh solve timing excludes setup, compilation and transfers.
Previous Armadillo extraction failures are unchanged and not presented as successful meshes.
The first captured-loop launch includes deferred graph instantiation and upload before its single graph launch; driver-internal preparation is not claimed host-free or allocation-free.
reproduction: Restore original .work/vtm paths and shared helpers/prior artifacts in checkouts of the pinned source commits; replace absolute workspace root as needed. Drivers refuse output overwrites.
Private probes use baseline5998b13; production validation uses the recorded runtime commit. Production imports no private prototype.

Use PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 WARP_CACHE_PATH=/opt/warpower-generated-cache OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 PYTHONPATH=.:.work/vtm. One GPU process at a time; no heavy CPU work during clean timing.
Build native CGAL validators from benchmarks/cpu; binary hashes are retained. /opt contains only regenerable cache/scratch.
